description: This file defines the API endpoints for a backend service managing jobs related to branding compliance analysis and fixing. It includes routes for creating, deleting, and monitoring jobs, uploading assets and reference images, triggering analysis, retrieving results, fixing assets, and downloading reports. It makes extensive use of FastAPI and Pydantic models, and interacts with various services and storage components to orchestrate the workflow.

classes.name: CreateJobRequest
classes.description: Data model for creating a new job, including optional owner, title, and description.

classes.name: CreateJobResponse
classes.description: Response model containing the ID of the created job.

classes.name: StatusResponse
classes.description: Model representing the status details of a job, including progress metrics.

classes.name: FixAssetRequest
classes.description: Model for request to fix a single asset, including strategy.

classes.name: BatchFixRequest
classes.description: Model for request to perform batch fixing across multiple assets, including strategy.

methods.name: create_job(data: CreateJobRequest, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Creates a new job with optional title and description, returning the job ID.

methods.name: delete_job(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Deletes a specified job and its workspace.

methods.name: upload_assets_zip(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Handles uploading and extracting a zip containing assets for a job.

methods.name: upload_old_brand(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Uploads an image of the old brand for analysis purposes.

methods.name: upload_new_brand(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Uploads an image of the new brand for fixing overlays.

methods.name: analyze_job(job_id: str, background: BackgroundTasks, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Triggers background analysis and preview generation for a job.

methods.name: get_status(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Retrieves current status and progress information for a job.

methods.name: get_results(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Returns assets and issues related to a job.

methods.name: get_asset_preview( job_id: str, asset_id: str, view: Literal["original", "overlay", "fixed"] = Query("original", description="Preview type"), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store), )
methods.description: Provides a preview image of a specified asset, with view options.

methods.name: fix_single_asset(job_id: str, asset_id: str, req: FixAssetRequest, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Performs an automatic fix on a specific asset.

methods.name: batch_fix(job_id: str, req: BatchFixRequest, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Runs automatic fixes across all assets with issues.

methods.name: download_artifacts( job_id: str, type: Literal["zip", "report", "both"] = Query("zip", description="Artifact type to download"), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store), )
methods.description: Prepares and serves downloadable reports or zip files for a job.
